audit_requirements: recompute proxy scores and trusted synthetic rewards
replay gradients and optimizer/Adam/RNG/checkpoint state for every completed case
check per-case VARE admission and durable journal
independently replay all baseline and completed post-training evaluations
compare D/E adapter, optimizer and RNG exactly per seed
verify all five required SIGKILL cutpoints across completed E arms
report case-level resources and every missing/partial case
campaign_completeness_rule: A passing subset audit does not change the campaign outcome: 13 of 15 preregistered cases completed, so whole-campaign PASS is impossible.
campaign_stop: resource abort at frozen 1200 second wall cap
inclusion_rule: Include every case directory in this run that has case-result.json at audit time, in lexical order. Do not filter cases by outcome. Include all three baseline evaluations. Exclude raw data in incomplete case directories from the completed-subset PASS and list it separately.
